entries.title: Project Glasswing: Securing critical software for the AI era
entries.summary_zh: Anthropic 推出 Project Glasswing，利用 Claude Mythos Preview AI 模型来识别和修复关键软件中的安全漏洞。该项目涉及多家科技公司，目标是保护关键基础设施免受网络威胁，体现了 AI 在网络安全防御方面的前沿应用。
entries.summary_en: Anthropic launches Project Glasswing, using Claude Mythos Preview AI model to identify and fix security vulnerabilities in critical software. The initiative involves multiple tech companies to protect critical infrastructure from cyber threats, showcasing cutting-edge applications of AI in cybersecurity defense.
entries.one_liner: AI驱动的安全漏洞检测将成为关键基础设施保护的标配

entries.title: Scaling Managed Agents: Decoupling the brain from the hands
entries.summary_zh: Anthropic 介绍了 Claude 平台中的托管代理服务，探讨如何将推理大脑与执行能力解耦，以支持长期的多步骤任务执行。文章分析了代理系统随模型演进而发展的架构变化。
entries.summary_en: Anthropic introduces managed agents service in Claude Platform, exploring how to decouple reasoning brain from execution capabilities to support long-horizon multi-step tasks. The article analyzes how agent system architectures evolve as models improve.
entries.one_liner: 代理架构的解耦设计是应对复杂长期任务的关键突破

entries.title: Improving instruction hierarchy in frontier LLMs
entries.summary_zh: OpenAI 研究前沿语言模型中的指令层次结构改进方法，探索如何提升模型对复杂指令的理解和执行能力，为多步骤任务处理提供更好的支持。
entries.summary_en: OpenAI explores improvements in instruction hierarchy within frontier language models, investigating how to enhance model understanding and execution of complex instructions for better multi-step task support.
entries.one_liner: 指令层次结构的优化是提升多步推理的关键技术

entries.title: Understanding why reasoning models struggle to control their chains of thought
entries.summary_zh: 研究揭示推理模型难以控制思维链的内在原因，发现这种'失控'实际上可能是模型的固有特性，而非缺陷。这一发现对理解模型行为有重要启示。
entries.summary_en: Research reveals why reasoning models struggle to control their chains of thought, finding that this 'lack of control' may actually be an inherent characteristic rather than a flaw, with important implications for understanding model behavior.
entries.one_liner: 推理模型的'失控'可能是其内在特性而非设计缺陷

entries.title: ConvApparel: Measuring and bridging the realism gap in user simulators
entries.summary_zh: Google Research 提出 ConvApparel 框架，用于测量和改善用户模拟器的真实感差距。该方法通过定量化评估帮助构建更准确的用户行为模型。
entries.summary_en: Google Research introduces ConvApparel framework to measure and bridge the realism gap in user simulators. This quantitative evaluation method helps build more accurate user behavior models.
entries.one_liner: 真实感量化评估是构建准确用户模拟器的重要工具

entries.title: Introducing two AI agents for better figures and peer review
entries.summary_zh: Google Research 推出两个 AI 代理工具，专门用于改进学术工作流程中的图表生成和同行评审过程，提升科研效率和质量。
entries.summary_en: Google Research launches two AI agent tools specifically designed to improve figure generation and peer review processes in academic workflows, enhancing research efficiency and quality.
entries.one_liner: AI 代理正在重塑学术研究的传统工作流程

entries.title: OpenAI 总裁Greg Brockman：AI 自我改进、Super App 豪赌、通往AGI 之路、算力扩张
entries.summary_zh: OpenAI 总裁 Greg Brockman 深度探讨 AI 自我改进机制、Super App 战略规划、AGI 发展路径以及算力扩张等核心议题，展现了对未来 AI 发展的战略思考。
entries.one_liner: OpenAI 的未来战略聚焦于自我改进、超级应用和算力扩张

entries.title: Claude Code 源码泄漏了，但我不打算写源码分析分析文章
entries.summary_zh: 分析 Claude Code 源码泄漏事件，探讨其对 AI 开发工具生态的影响，以及从工程角度理解开源工具的价值和风险。
entries.one_liner: Claude Code 源码泄漏事件揭示了 AI 开发工具的生态复杂性

entries.title: 飞书CLI开源了，为什么AI Agent时代，大家都在做命令行工具？
entries.summary_zh: 深度分析飞书CLI开源现象，探讨AI Agent时代命令行工具重新兴起的趋势，以及CLI在智能体工作流中的核心作用。
entries.one_liner: CLI工具在AI Agent时代的回归体现了对高效工作流的需求

entries.title: Model Context Protocol (MCP): USB-C端口标准的AI实现
entries.summary_zh: 深入探讨 Model Context Protocol 作为 AI 系统互操作标准的重要性，它就像 AI 领域的 USB-C 端口，正在成为企业 AI 基础设施的标准配置。
entries.summary_en: Deep dive into Model Context Protocol as an interoperability standard for AI systems, acting as the 'USB-C port for AI' and becoming foundational enterprise AI infrastructure in 2026.
entries.one_liner: MCP 正在成为 AI 生态系统互联互通的基础设施

entries.title: 2026年多智能体系统：从单体模型到协作架构
entries.summary_zh: 分析2026年多智能体系统的兴起趋势，探讨从单体语言模型向协作架构的转变，以及这对企业工作流程自动化决策的根本性改变。
entries.summary_en: Analysis of multi-agent system emergence in 2026, exploring the shift from monolithic language models to collaborative architectures and their fundamental impact on enterprise workflow automation.
entries.one_liner: 2026年标志着多智能体架构从概念走向实际部署的关键节点

entries.title: Evaluating alignment of behavioral dispositions in LLMs
entries.summary_zh: Google Research 提出新的对齐评估方法，专门针对大型语言模型中的行为倾向对齐问题，为AI安全和可靠性提供更精准的评估工具。
entries.summary_en: Google Research introduces new alignment evaluation methodology specifically targeting behavioral disposition alignment in large language models, providing more precise tools for AI safety and reliability.
entries.one_liner: 行为倾向对齐评估成为AI安全的重要研究方向

entries.title: Agent2Agent Protocol (A2A)：智能体间通信的新标准
entries.summary_zh: 介绍 Agent2Agent Protocol 作为智能体间通信的新标准，探讨其在多智能体系统中的作用以及与MCP协议的协同关系。
entries.summary_en: Introduction to Agent2Agent Protocol as a new standard for inter-agent communication, exploring its role in multi-agent systems and synergy with MCP protocol.
entries.one_liner: A2A协议为智能体间通信提供了标准化的解决方案

entries.title: Veo 3.1 Lite：成本优化的视频生成模型
entries.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 发布 Veo 3.1 Lite 模型，这是成本优化的视频生成解决方案，在保持高质量的同时大幅降低了计算成本，为更广泛的应用场景提供支持。
entries.summary_en: Google DeepMind releases Veo 3.1 Lite, a cost-optimized video generation model that maintains high quality while significantly reducing computational costs, supporting broader application scenarios.
entries.one_liner: 成本优化是AI模型大规模商业化的关键挑战

entries.title: Pi: The Minimal Agent Within OpenClaw
entries.summary_zh: Pi 是 OpenClaw 中的极简编程 Agent，仅使用系统提示词、文件读取、文件写入和一个 LLM 主循环驱动。不同于复杂的智能体框架，Pi 追求「做少做精」——读取文件、做修改、由 LLM 决定执行命令。UI 参考 Codex，支持分支会话用于代码审查，以及快速查看最近提到的文件。
entries.summary_en: Pi is a minimal coding agent for OpenClaw that uses a simple system prompt, a file reader, a file writer, and a main loop running an LLM that interprets observations and decides whether to execute commands. Rather than building complex orchestration, Pi focuses on doing one thing well: reading files, making changes, and letting the LLM drive everything. The UI is modeled after Codex with easy-to-review commits, diffs, and uncommitted changes. The agent supports branching sessions for review and uses shift+ctrl+r for quick-look of recently mentioned files.
entries.one_liner: 极简设计哲学的编程 Agent，或将成为 AI 辅助开发的主流范式

entries.title: DeerFlow 2.0: ByteDance Open-Source AI Agent Harness
entries.summary_zh: DeerFlow（深度探索高效研究流）是字节跳动开源的 AI Agent 工具，通过编排子 Agent、记忆和沙箱执行深度研究任务。2.0 版本于 2026 年 2 月 28 日登顶 GitHub Trending #1，支持豆宝-Seed-2.0-Code、DeepSeek v3.2 和 Kimi 2.5 等模型，集成了自研智能搜索和爬虫工具集。
entries.summary_en: DeerFlow (Deep Exploration and Efficient Research Flow) is an open-source AI agent harness by ByteDance that orchestrates sub-agents, memory, and sandboxes for deep research tasks. Version 2.0 is a ground-up rewrite that became GitHub Trending #1 on Feb 28, 2026. It recommends using Doubao-Seed-2.0-Code, DeepSeek v3.2 and Kimi 2.5 models. The framework integrates a proprietary intelligent search and crawling toolset, supports both standard mode with LangGraph Platform and local development mode.
entries.one_liner: 字节跳动开源的深度研究 Agent 框架，2.0 重写登顶 GitHub Trending

entries.title: PhoneDriver: 使用 Qwen3-VL 的 Android 手机控制
entries.summary_zh: PhoneDriver 是一个基于 Python 的移动自动化 Agent，使用 Qwen3-VL 视觉-语言模型通过视觉分析和 ADB 命令来理解和控制 Android 设备。具有视觉驱动的自动化、自然语言任务描述、内置 Gradio 界面和实时反馈等特点，支持 Qwen3-VL 4B/8B 稠密模型和 MoE 变体。
entries.summary_en: PhoneDriver is a Python-based mobile automation agent using Qwen3-VL vision-language models to understand and interact with Android devices through visual analysis and ADB commands. It features vision-powered automation that understands phone screens, natural language task descriptions, a built-in Gradio interface, and real-time feedback. Supports both dense Qwen3-VL 4B/8B models and MoE variants. Installation is via pip with HuggingFace Transformers.
entries.one_liner: Qwen3-VL 视觉驱动 Android 控制，LLM Agent 在移动端自动化的新尝试

entries.title: Superpowers: 编码 Agent 的完整软件开发生命周期工作流
entries.summary_zh: Superpowers 是一个面向编程 Agent 的完整软件开发周期工作流，构建在可组合的技能之上。它先让用户明确真正要做什么，然后展示分块规格说明供审核，审核通过后生成 junior 工程师级别的实现计划，强调红/绿 TDD、YAGNI 和 DRY 原则。包含提问、规格说明、项目引导、计划实现、代码审查、测试运行和 Git 提交等技能。
entries.summary_en: Superpowers is a complete software development lifecycle workflow for coding agents, built on composable skills. When activated, it asks the user what they are really trying to build, then shows a chunked spec for review. After sign-off, it creates an implementation plan for a junior-engineer-level agent to follow, emphasizing red/green TDD, YAGNI, and DRY principles. It includes skills for asking clarifying questions, writing specs, bootstrapping projects, planning implementations, reviewing code, running tests, and managing git commits.
entries.one_liner: Spec 驱动的编程 Agent 工作流，强调先理解需求再动手
